unit.title: A Second Folk Tale: The Ant and the Grasshopper

contentBlocks.text: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਤਿਹਾਈ ਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪੜ੍ਹੀ। ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਇੱਕ ਹੋਰ ਲੋਕ ਕਹਾਣੀ! (Last week you read the Thirsty Crow story. This week, another folk tale!)

This week's story is about two very different animals during changing seasons. Learn 4 new words: ਕੀੜੀ (ant), ਟਿੱਡਾ (grasshopper), ਸਰਦੀ (winter), and ਤਿਆਰੀ (preparation). Practice: use ਕੀੜੀ and ਤਿਆਰੀ in one sentence describing an ant getting ready for something.
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਨਵੇਂ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਸਿੱਖੇ! (You just learned new words!) Tomorrow we'll read the real story using them.

objectives: Learn 4 new vocabulary words needed for this week's folk tale: ਕੀੜੀ/ਟਿੱਡਾ/ਸਰਦੀ/ਤਿਆਰੀ
Use ਕੀੜੀ and ਤਿਆਰੀ correctly in an original sentence
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review last week's Thirsty Crow story briefly.
2. Introduce this week's 4 new words.
3. Have the child build a sentence using ਕੀੜੀ and ਤਿਆਰੀ.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's story, which uses this week's full vocabulary.
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just ਕੀੜੀ and ਸਰਦੀ first, the two most central words to the story
Ready for more: ask the child to predict what the story might be about, based only on this week's 4 vocabulary words
This lesson directly sets up the course's 'Punjabi folk tales' description, previewing vocabulary before the story itself, same pattern as last week
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a vocabulary-acquisition activity — check that the child correctly traces/writes all 4 new words and builds a real sentence using ਕੀੜੀ and ਤਿਆਰੀ together.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'Punjabi folk tales' and 'basic composition' goals together, pre-teaching key vocabulary before this week's real story.

generationData.instructions: Trace each word, then copy it once on your own.
